page_title: AST 4-2 NOT | Aston Villa v Nottingham Forest 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) works the corner short.

90+4' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Ollie Watkins is replaced by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa).
90+2' It will be a substitution. Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Leon Bailey walks off.
90+1' Divock Origi (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Danilo (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham).

86' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
85' The corner kick from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

85' John McGinn (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.

84' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.

84' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle. Aston Villa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
83' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
82' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Youri Tielemans and he is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White will be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham).
81' Divock Origi (Nottingham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.

80' A clever short pass gives Matty Cash (Aston Villa) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
80' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
78' Danilo (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
76' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Samuel Barrott blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

76' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
74' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Nottingham will take a free kick near the side line.
73' Here is a change. Nicolas Dominguez is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
72' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
71' Samuel Barrott blows the whistle, Divock Origi (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Aston Villa earn a free kick.
71' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

67' Emiliano Martinez makes a brilliant save! Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
64' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
61' 4 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Leon Bailey (Aston Villa), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 4:2.
59' Substitution. Alex Moreno will be replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
58' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
57' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' The foul by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Samuel Barrott.
57' Neco Williams (Nottingham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
55' Divock Origi (Nottingham) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

54' Danilo (Nottingham) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
54' Divock Origi (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

53' OFF THE POST! Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
51' Divock Origi (Nottingham) trips an opposition player and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. Aston Villa have a free kick.

50' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
48' 3 - 2 Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball in the middle of the goal.
46' Half-time substitution. Nuno Espirito Santo decided to make a change. Taiwo Awoniyi is replaced by Divock Origi (Nottingham).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Nuno Espirito Santo probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Felipe. He is replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Nuno Espirito Santo gives a chance to Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) and Murillo is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is replaced by Calum Chambers.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' 3 - 1 Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) scores using an unorthodox part of his body!
45+5' The referee blows his whistle, Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
45+5' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
45+3' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+3' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Samuel Barrott blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Aston Villa.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Felipe (Nottingham) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Samuel Barrott didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

43' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.

43' Close! Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
42' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

39' 3 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from John McGinn finds Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the roof of the net. His effort was both strong and precise, and Matz Sels had no chance of stopping that. 3:0.
39' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

38' So close! Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
38' Felipe (Nottingham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Aston Villa will take a free kick.
36' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
34' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

29' 2 - 0 Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Jacob Ramsey, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
28' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
24' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. One of the players from Aston Villa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
24' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
23' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Murillo (Nottingham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. Aston Villa have a free kick.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.

20' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) gets inside the box and tries to beat Matz Sels with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
16' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Aston Villa.
15' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Murillo (Nottingham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
14' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
14' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Nottingham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' Aston Villa are ruled offside.
10' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

10' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
10' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

7' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Leon Bailey slips a clever pass through to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
4' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Samuel Barrott interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
2' The referee blows his whistle as Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
